title: IRIS Lab publications
description: List of publications. Shared with hoak.me, so keep keys stable once published.

key.description: Unique, stable identifier, e.g. lastname_keyword_year. Never change it once merged.

authors.description: Author list joined with ' and ', e.g. 'Ada Lovelace and Blaine Hoak'. Mark equal contribution with '*'.

venue.description: Full venue name with abbreviation, e.g. 'USENIX Security Symposium'.

group.description: Publication type. 'submission' entries are never shown on the lab site.

lab.description: true for work done in the IRIS Lab. Prior work may be included separately as a research_example.

research_example.description: Opt prior work into Research as example content without changing lab affiliation. Submissions remain hidden.

highlight.description: Optional personal-site highlight selection, retained for hoak.me compatibility. Does not control IRIS Research visibility.

image.description: Absolute URL of a teaser image, normally https://iris-research-lab.github.io/assets/images/publications/<file>.

label.description: e.g. Paper, Code, Dataset, Poster, Slides, Talk, Blog
